runs.text: Pro-Israel and pro-peace? Here's how to say it, in eight words. Dinner with friends. You mention Israel, and someone asks: So, you're against Palestinians? I'm pro-Israel and pro-peace. Those are not opposites. It's not just a slogan. In nineteen seventy nine, Israel made peace with Egypt and gave back the Sinai. In nineteen ninety four, peace with Jordan. And in twenty twenty two, about one hundred and ninety three thousand Palestinians worked in Israel and the settlements, for more than twice the local wage. Save this one. Pro-Israel. Pro-peace. Not opposites. Which sentence do you need most? Tell me in the comments. And it all starts with eight words.
